title: Microsoft Service Outage Could Mean Bill Credits
excerpt: Businesses affected by a recent Microsoft outage last week may be eligible for a partial credit on their upcoming monthly bill.
body_html:
Organizations that experienced downtime with Microsoft business services last week might qualify for financial compensation. According to reports, affected customers are likely entitled to receive a partial credit on their next monthly subscription bill.

The potential credits apply specifically to business accounts that faced disruptions while using the services. Users can check the details of their service agreements and billing statements to see if they qualify for the adjustment based on the recent downtime.
